content: Hello, we have a request from a researcher asking us to update their (SSO-provided) first name. In the campus directory I see a givenName that Dataverse is using, and an eduPersonNickname with the desired value. It is my understanding that Dataverse will update Shibboleth attributes in the DB at each sign-in, I'm curious how many installations have encountered such name change requests?
I think we always just explain that Dataverse will use givenName.
